landing.title: Stop replaying the whole clip.
landing.intro: DeepListener turns your own English audio and video into a sentence-level practice loop: blind listening, waveform precision, shadowing, diagnosis, and spaced review.
landing.privacy: Your media and database stay local; provider keys remain under your control.
landing.loopTitle: From "I know every word" to "I can actually hear it."
landing.aiTitle: AI where it removes work, not where it creates noise.
landing.aiText: OpenAI, Deepgram, or Google can create a time-aligned transcript from your media. You choose the provider and bring the key. There is no generic chatbot and no hidden cloud account.
landing.ready: Ready for your first listening session?
landing.readyText: Run the read-only environment check before importing media.

listen.title: Listen blind
listen.text: Hide the transcript and find the exact moment your comprehension breaks.

decode.title: Decode the sentence
decode.text: Zoom, loop, slow down, and mark linking, reductions, vocabulary, or speed.

shadow.title: Shadow the rhythm
shadow.text: Record your voice and compare timing against the original waveform.

review.title: Review what mattered
review.text: Save difficult sentences and revisit them with FSRS scheduling.

local.title: Local-first
local.text: SQLite, uploads, and original video remain on the host running DeepListener.

byok.title: BYOK
byok.text: Only the transcription provider you select receives audio for transcription.

selfhosted.title: Self-hosted boundary
selfhosted.text: No authentication is included; use it locally or behind a protected network.

landing.exampleText: "What makes natural speech difficult isn't always the vocabulary."

setup.title: Setup
setup.heading: Know what works before importing media.
setup.subtitle: These checks are read-only. They do not create a database, change your configuration, contact a provider, or reveal credential values.
setup.summaryDetail: {ready} of {total} checks are ready. Limited items describe optional features or safe-use boundaries.
setup.providerNote: Provider connectivity is intentionally checked only when you import media, because a live probe would send a credentialed external request and may incur cost. This page never uploads your media.

safetyNotice.title: Local-only by design
safetyNotice.body: DeepListener has no built-in user authentication. Do not expose this server directly to the public internet. Put authentication and TLS in front of it if remote access is required.

providerDialog.title: Configure transcription provider
providerDialog.description: Choose a speech-to-text provider and enter its API key. Desktop builds store it in macOS Keychain; other local runs use a protected file. Saving the key does not send media or test connectivity. It is never shown again.
providerDialog.replaceHint: A key is already configured for this provider. Enter a new one to replace it.
providerDialog.getKeyHint: Get a key from your provider's dashboard and paste it here.
providerDialog.howToGetKey: How do I get a key?
providerDialog.howToGetKeyHint: Not sure how to apply? Click here for steps and links.
providerDialog.openConsoleHint: Opens the official console in a new tab.
providerDialog.deepgramSteps:
1. Sign up at console.deepgram.com.
2. New accounts usually receive free credit; check the Dashboard.
3. Go to API Keys and click Create API Key.
4. Copy the generated key and paste it into the field above.
providerDialog.openaiSteps:
1. Sign up and sign in at platform.openai.com.
2. Add a payment method under Settings → Billing (Whisper is pay-as-you-go).
3. Go to API Keys and click Create new secret key.
4. Copy the generated key (starts with sk-) and paste it above.
Note: Access from mainland China may require a proxy.
providerDialog.googleSteps:
1. Sign in with a Google account at aistudio.google.com.
2. Accept the terms, then create a key on the Get API Key page.
3. Copy the generated API key and paste it above.
Note: Some regions may need a proxy to reach Google.
providerDialog.useBaseUrl: Use a custom OpenAI-compatible base URL
providerDialog.baseUrlHint: For OpenAI-compatible gateways or regional proxies. Leave blank to use the default endpoint.
